The '''Kelligdyd 5000 cannon''' was an artillery piece used during the [[Republic Dark Age]], the last [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. It was used by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] factions like [[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]]'s [[Rusher's Brigade]]. Kelligdyd 5000 cannons were attached to the troopship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence's'']] cargo ramps and could be quickly deployed in battle. They saw action during the [[Battle of Gazzari]], the [[Battle of Byllura]], and the [[Siege of Calimondretta]].
